name: N8N-PUPPETEER
description: Production-ready n8n workflow automation engine built with Puppeteer for web scraping and a dedicated Postgres database instance.

PORT.description: The network port on which the n8n web server listens for incoming HTTP requests.

DB_TYPE.description: The structural database core type backend configured for n8n execution data.

NODES_EXCLUDE.description: Array block list configuration indicating which default core nodes to completely disable.

DB_POSTGRESDB_HOST.description: The private network endpoint hostname mapped to the active PostgreSQL storage container.

DB_POSTGRESDB_PORT.description: The network gateway port interface utilized to route incoming traffic to the database.

DB_POSTGRESDB_USER.description: The system credential account name utilized to authenticate structural database access queries.

DB_POSTGRESDB_DATABASE.description: The targeted active runtime relational database cluster schema created inside Postgres.

DB_POSTGRESDB_PASSWORD.description: The master cryptographic password string utilized for authorization protocols.

N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED.description: Toggles execution tasks to isolate heavy workloads onto decoupled runner frameworks.

N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED.description: Toggles the automatic reporting payload of anonymous backend diagnostics telemetry.

PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH.description: The absolute system environment path routing directly to the local browser binary executable.

N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_ENABLED.description: Controls permissions to fetch, install, and instantiate external community nodes.

PUPPETEER_SKIP_CHROMIUM_DOWNLOAD.description: Instructs node modules to skip fetching a secondary browser package during builds.

N8N_VERSION_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED.description: Controls visual notifications alerting users about updated application framework releases.

N8N_ENFORCE_SETTINGS_FILE_PERMISSIONS.description: Bypasses default rigid file-ownership permissions evaluation parameters.

PGDATA.description: The absolute folder location where cluster storage files are saved.

PGHOST.description: The binding routing target network address pointing to this specific host entity.

PGPORT.description: The target TCP communication port network interface for standard service calls.

PGUSER.description: The system user identity assigned administrative powers on database clusters.

PGDATABASE.description: The designated core relational target workspace name within the storage container.

PGPASSWORD.description: The master credential credential utilized for security clearance checks.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Alternative environmental flag passing initialization naming commands.

DATABASE_URL.description: The comprehensive fully formatted application system routing access URI string.

POSTGRES_USER.description: Alternative environmental flag passing configuration username inputs.

SSL_CERT_DAYS.description: The standard total active timeline allocated for custom system generation security certifications.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Alternative environmental configuration target handling master initialization secrets.

DATABASE_PUBLIC_URL.description: The external public facing egress proxy routing URI for remote system access hooks.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: The graceful countdown timeframe buffer mapped out before cycling running instances.
